'''Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children''' was an orphanage located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] of [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="Dash" /> [[Ri'kan Kateen|Ri'kan]] and [[Sa'har Kateen]] spent their earliest years in the orphanage sometime before the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Sa'har Kateen}}</ref> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> [[Dirlid Bond]] was the director of the orphanage.<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Thank you for your generosity|Director Dirlid Bond}}</ref>
